name: Knott's Soak City Longboard's Grill Charbroiled Chicken Breast on Brioche
brandOrRestaurant: Knott's Soak City Waterpark (Buena Park, CA)
whyItWorks: Clean, lean poolside dining! Boneless skinless chicken breast charbroiled and served on a soft bun with potato chips. Unbreaded and gentle between water slides.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Charbroiled Chicken Sandwich plain or with mayo (hold lettuce and tomato slices).
